title: smime-tree cert.rs: chain_depth variable name is misleading — it counts pathLen intermediates, not loop depth
description: cert.rs: the variable chain_depth tracks 'count of non-self-issued intermediate CA certs accumulated below the current position' for RFC 5280 §4.2.1.9 pathLen semantics. But chain_depth sounds like it counts iteration steps (which is _depth). A future contributor checking the pathLen code will need to re-read the comments carefully to understand why chain_depth starts at 0, increments only for intermediates, and is checked against path_len using >. Suggested rename: intermediate_count or path_len_so_far.
